question: Which active phase 3 trials with sites in Japan finish in the next 12 months?
sql:
SELECT t.nct_id, t.brief_title, t.lead_org_name, t.phase, t.primary_completion_date,
       count(*) AS japan_sites
FROM marts.dim_trial AS t
JOIN marts.fct_trial_sites AS s USING (nct_id)
WHERE s.country = 'Japan'
  AND t.is_active
  AND t.phase IN ('PHASE3', 'PHASE2_PHASE3')
  AND t.primary_completion_date >= DATE '2026-11-03'
  AND t.primary_completion_date < DATE '2027-11-03'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY t.primary_completion_date
LIMIT 500
